name: react-vite travel SPA (phx-project)
observations: AGENTS.md at repo root is the main project brain; follow it as the unified system with included rules/skills.
Rules: Always follow UIUX Promax (see .cursor/rules/ui-ux-pro-max.mdc and skills/ui-ux-pro-max).
Rules: Always use Zustand for client state.
Rules: Always use React Query (TanStack Query) for server state.
Rules: All API calls go through the services layer.
Behavior: Think like a senior React engineer; prefer scalable and maintainable solutions.
When refactoring: Improve structure; do not break logic; reduce complexity; ensure consistency with project patterns.
When working on UI: Improve spacing and hierarchy; avoid generic layouts; always include loading, empty, and error states.
